purpose: Single machine-readable register of decisions that are still open or only defaulted. Every entry carries a development default, a status and the switch that changes it, so work can continue without silently turning a default into a claim.

status_vocabulary.pending: Waiting on the named owner. Usable only as a labelled development default.
status_vocabulary.provisional_default: A recorded default is in force for development. It is not a physics sign-off.
status_vocabulary.adopted: Binding internal decision by the author. Not a review by Junjie.
status_vocabulary.confirmed: Explicitly confirmed by the named physics owner (Junjie) or by a dated amendment.
status_vocabulary.retired: Superseded by another entry; kept for history.

claim_gate_rule: A claim/held-out run (WP7 or any Claim-1/Claim-2 comparison) may start only when every entry with claim_gate=true has status=confirmed. An author waiver must be recorded as a dated amendment and does not change the status.

decisions.title: Energy endpoint
decisions.question: Which energy target does Claim 2 rank: (A) deposited energy inside the instrumented volume, primary endpoint on contained muons at 100-300 MeV kinetic; (B) drop energy, keep vertex and direction only; (C) other?
alternatives: B: no energy endpoint; vertex and direction only
C: another endpoint supplied by Junjie
decisions.switch: Record Junjie's answer in docs/PMT_DECISIONS_LOG.md, edit the wp6 contract under a dated amendment, set status=confirmed. No code change unless the choice is (C).
decisions.notes: The R-4/R-4b/R-4c pilot already uses (A) as a labelled development default. The endpoint is ill-posed for escaping tracks (geometry, not reconstruction), which is why contained muons are the primary case.

decisions.title: Transfer arm
decisions.question: Keep NuRadioMC as the transfer arm, or replace it with an LArTPC/JAXTPC arm?
alternatives: NuRadioMC (pilot not run)
JAXTPC as replacement, not an addition
decisions.switch: Set transfer_arm in the arm registry and record the decision; no arm code exists yet, so the switch is documentation-level until a build is authorised.
decisions.notes: Junjie's 'Okies' is read as leaving the arm unstarted, not as choosing JAXTPC. No JAXTPC or NuRadioMC commit exists.

decisions.title: LUCiD role in Paper 3
decisions.question: Keep LUCiD as a Claim-1 null control plus Claim-2 replication, or drop it from Paper 3?

default.paper3_use: only if the arm is kept

alternatives: Retain as control/replication
Drop from Paper 3 (JEPA still uses LUCiD)
decisions.switch: Record the decision; the WP8 draft already contains both options.
decisions.notes: The JEPA study uses LUCiD regardless; this entry only concerns Paper 3/ORACLE.

decisions.title: Category M (modelling changes)
decisions.question: Keep simulation-model changes (angular acceptance, medium scattering/absorption) excluded from both claims as their own category M, or give M an origin label so it can be reported as an abstention target?
alternatives: Excluded, no origin label (default)
Own origin label M / abstention target
decisions.switch: Add an M origin label to the cell contract if Junjie wants it; otherwise no change.
decisions.notes: Junjie's 'agreed with the rest' is read as accepting exclusion; the WP8 draft still lists D-M, so ask for a one-line confirmation rather than a fresh decision.

decisions.title: TIDMAD signal family and held-out definition
decisions.question: What is the clean S family and the held-out definition for TIDMAD, and is the controlled-N injection on the 208 noise-only files the right baseline?
alternatives: Define S families before any TIDMAD claim
Keep TIDMAD as an engineering/feasibility arm
decisions.switch: Record the S definition and held-out split; the injection machinery needs no change.
decisions.notes: Controlled N is code plus tests only; it has not been run on real files.

decisions.title: K aggregation and kappa_m
decisions.question: Use K=max(K_vertex,K_energy) as the primary harm statistic with kappa_m=1.10?
alternatives: Single-endpoint K
Geometric-mean or other aggregation
decisions.switch: Author amendment plus precision study; re-check if any WP7 cell holds fewer than 12 physical events.
decisions.notes: Adopted by the author, not reviewed by Junjie. kappa_m = 1.10 came from SD_K=0.040; it stays provisional_dev.

decisions.title: T-Q walk form and values
decisions.question: Is walk(q)=a+b/sqrt(q) acceptable, or should the polynomial / a thesis-derived Eq. 5.13 curve be used?
alternatives: Polynomial approximation (Junjie's request; kept as legacy)
Eq. 5.13-type curve with an explicit charge-coordinate conversion
decisions.switch: Set walk.form/values in reference.json (new manifest hash + amendment) and update the contract. The polynomial implementation is retained as legacy.
decisions.notes: The form change to 1/sqrt(q) is an author decision of 18 Oct and directly departs from Junjie's 'use a polynomial approximation'; his acceptance is not recorded. per_channel_slope_sigma=0 reproduces the current single global curve; a nonzero value would enable the per-channel Q-T correlation he asked for, once the implementation lands.

decisions.title: Effective QE.CE product and target calibration
decisions.question: What is the target effective QE(lambda)*CE for the WCTE 3-inch PMTs (>=3 wavelength points), and what dark rate applies?
alternatives: Measured QE(lambda) and CE supplied separately (but QE and CE are degenerate in situ)
Effective product QE*CE supplied directly (preferred)
decisions.switch: Update reference.json under a new manifest version with new sha256 provenance and a dated amendment; the exact QE*CE degeneracy control stays.
decisions.notes: The exact QE x2 / CE /2 control passes with bit-identical digits, so no identifiability is claimed. Ask for the effective product, not separate curves.

decisions.title: Per-PMT QE variance
decisions.question: Should the baseline include a per-PMT QE spread, and what is its size?
alternatives: Keep 0.0 (current reference has one global QE curve)
Set a measured/declared spread, e.g. 5% as a documented synthetic value
Per-PMT QE spread declared part of the reference (taxonomy decision)
blocks: baseline realism for the QE family
decisions.switch: Implement the per-channel QE factor in the readout, then set the sigma in a new manifest version. Default 0.0 is bit-identical to today.
decisions.notes: The original issue #5 request (inject variance on PMT QE) is not implemented: the reference uses one global QE curve. It was reclassified as reference rather than N, but the spread itself was never built.

decisions.title: Per-channel Q-T correlation
decisions.question: Should each channel have its own T-Q curve at training time (Junjie's request), and what is the spread?
alternatives: Single global curve (current)
Per-channel lognormal slope factors with a declared sigma
Measured per-channel curves from calibration
decisions.switch: Build a ChannelWalkCurve from an InverseSqrtWalk per channel, then set the sigma in the manifest; default 0.0 preserves the current single-curve outputs.
decisions.notes: Junjie asked for a training-time per-channel Q-T correlation with a different one at test time, so a changed correlation shifts hit times instead of losing charge. Current T-Q cells change one global slope (b x 0.8/1.2).

decisions.title: Grouping: mPMT modules versus crates
decisions.question: Use the 105 mPMT modules as response groups, or a physical crate/cable map?
alternatives: mPMT modules (current; pinned geometry)
Physical crate/cable map if supplied
decisions.switch: Supply the channel-to-crate map and pass it as channel_group; the reference builder needs no change.
decisions.notes: Junjie said 'per-crate effect is a good idea'; without a map the response groups are mPMT modules (D-G).

decisions.title: Angular-acceptance model
decisions.question: When does a PMT angular-acceptance model enter, and is it N or M?
alternatives: Uniform acceptance for the first trial (current)
Inject a different acceptance model next iteration
Physical acceptance drift after training (would be N)
decisions.switch: Add the acceptance model to the transport and classify it M or N; current cells assume uniform AA.
decisions.notes: Junjie deferred this to the next iteration ('no concentrator for now; uniform AA').

decisions.title: Cherenkov-cone / energy-loss diagnostic
decisions.question: Do we adopt the ToF-vertex -> opening-angle -> Eloss diagnostic, and at what stage?
alternatives: Local photon-level closure only (current)
Reconstructed ring axis and opening angle
Full Eloss-history comparison
decisions.switch: Implement the reconstructed-cone estimator on the frozen track reconstruction; no claim path depends on it.
decisions.notes: The current check validates the emitter angle against 1/(beta n) (median 0.46 deg); it is not Junjie's ToF-vertex cone/Eloss test.

decisions.title: Launch of the claim comparison
decisions.question: When is WP7 (the Claim-1/Claim-2 comparison) launched?
alternatives: Launch once the claim-gate decisions are confirmed
Keep WP7 blocked
decisions.switch: Author says 'launch WP7' after D-E, D-QE and D-TQ are confirmed; record the message verbatim.
decisions.notes: The author has not launched WP7. No model has been trained with a response variant.

decisions.title: LUCiD licence file and redistribution
decisions.question: Is a LICENSE file needed for our use, and is redistribution approved?
alternatives: Research use only, no redistribution (current)
Add an upstream licence before any release
decisions.switch: Junjie pins a licence upstream; record it and update the source contract.
decisions.notes: The missing file never blocked running LUCiD internally; the earlier 'blocker' framing was wrong.
